items.caption:
Swipe to see why a16z just renamed its crypto arm.

Andreessen Horowitz is renaming a16z Crypto to a16z Frontier and widening the scope of its new fund beyond crypto, to frontier startups building new technologies and markets, including AI and robotics.

The fund is $2.2B. In the announcement, Chris Dixon says a16z will keep investing in crypto, but the label matters less now: companies should be defined by what they do, not the technology they use.

Sources: a16z, BigGo Finance.

One Higgsfield employee spent over $30,000 in a single week on an AI model.

CEO Alex Mashrabov says a member of the creative team, frustrated with an asset-organization workflow, built his own tool over five straight nights. It worked and the team learned a lot, though Alex says it was not production ready. Many people on the team spend over $10,000 a week.

Full conversation: 20VC with Harry Stebbings and Alex Mashrabov, founder of Higgsfield.

items.caption:
Swipe to see the YC startup fixing the week before a new hire’s first day.

Firstwork builds AI agents for companies with large frontline workforces in healthcare, logistics and delivery. The agents handle the gap between a job offer and the first shift: collecting documents, coordinating onboarding and tracking credential expiry dates. Customers include Deel, Job&Talent and Wonolo.

The New York-based startup raised a $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital, with Legion VC, Deel Ventures and existing backers Gradient and Y Combinator. Total funding is now $20M.

Founded in 2024 by Vardhan Kapoor, formerly Deliveroo’s head of strategy, with CTO Shubham Choudhary.

Sources: Indian Startup News, Tech Funding News.

items.caption:
Swipe to see the startup building computers for AI agents.

Daytona builds a cloud for long-running AI agents, giving each agent sandboxed access to Linux, Windows, macOS and GPUs on one platform. CEO Ivan Burazin calls it “like giving every agent its own computer.”

The New York-based startup raised a $60M Series B led by FirstMark Growth at a $1B valuation, with Qualcomm Ventures, Samsung Next and Okta Ventures. It has raised $91M in total.

Angel investors include Patrick Collison (Stripe), Tobi Lütke (Shopify), Aravind Srinivas (Perplexity), Eric Yuan (Zoom) and Olivier Pomel (Datadog).

Source: TechCrunch.

items.caption:
Swipe to see the AI video startup Nvidia just backed.

Higgsfield makes AI image and video tools for creators, brand marketers and agencies.

On October 23 it extended its Series B with new investment from TCV and NVIDIA. That round was led by DST Global in August, when Higgsfield raised $400M at a $5.4B valuation.

The company says it has more than 40 million users across 238 countries and crossed $1B in annualized revenue run rate in September, 18 months after launch.

Sources: Higgsfield, Indian Television.
